name: form-d-exempt-offering-notice
description: Drafts SEC Form D notices of exempt offering and Form D/A amendments for operating companies and pooled investment funds, mapped one-to-one to the form's 16 items. Runs a source-review gate over the matter inventory, builds an evidence-to-field worksheet for every item, reconciles subscription documents, governing documents and administrator ledgers issuer by issuer, determines the date of first sale and the filing deadline, identifies amendment triggers, records EDGAR and BrokerCheck lookup outcomes precisely, and plans EDGAR access (Form ID, EDGAR Next) for new issuers. On request, builds the filing package: draft Form D XML for an EDGAR test submission, an Online Forms keying sheet and a pre-submission checklist for the person who files. Use for Form D, Form D/A, Reg D notice, notice of exempt offering, fund closing filings, parallel fund, feeder fund, or EDGAR filing for a private placement.
